log:
FluentMusic v1.3.8 Optics, High-Refresh Lyrics & Light Mode Fixes:
- 60Hz/90Hz/120Hz Vsync Ticker interpolation engine for lyrics, bypassing the 250ms threshold to eliminate jitter and vocal lag
- Progressive word-level karaoke interpolation for lines without word sync, ensuring smooth syllable gliding
- Fixed search icon staying white in Light Mode across bottom navigation
- Complete Light Mode contrast overhaul in Library and Settings subpages (PlaylistBar, quick links, and all 9 settings subpages)
- Liquid Glass refraction sharpening: reduced default blur to 8px and expanded blur slider down to 2px so optical lens distortion is crisp and distinct
- Added live Hardware Shader Pipeline diagnostic in Settings > Liquid Glass
